About Me

My Story

Programming Journey

My journey began with a natural fascination for how code translates into interactive visual interfaces. Starting from HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript, I discovered the joy of bringing designs to life.

I soon immersed myself in the React & Next.js ecosystem and TypeScript, before leveling up into full-stack development with Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and authentication systems. Every project has been an opportunity to write cleaner, more resilient code.
